cells.gaps: The cell rests on one National Treasury circular of December 2023, which describes every municipality's property-rates billing report and its reconciliation to the valuation roll and gives no count or share of municipalities billing from a system. No fact on governance and none inside the last twelve months is held.
cells.note: The circular describes municipalities billing property rates per property and owner from their own billing systems, which is register and local with coverage not published. Stage 4 needs more than half of municipalities on a share or a count with a denominator, and the evidence holds no count at all.
